guarantees.claim: On asynchronous reset (rst_ni low), nco_sum_q is cleared to 17'h0.
When tx_enable or rx_enable is active, nco_sum_q updates to the 17‑bit zero‑extended sum of nco_sum_q[NcoWidth‑1:0] and reg2hw.ctrl.nco.q[NcoWidth‑1:0].
When both tx_enable and rx_enable are low, nco_sum_q retains its previous value.

assumptions.claim: NcoWidth must be ≤ 16 so that the 17‑bit nco_sum_q register can hold the NCO accumulator result without truncation.
assumptions.risk: If NcoWidth > 16, the assignment truncates the sum to 17 bits, losing the most significant overflow bit and corrupting the NCO phase.

uncertain_points.claim: The NCO overflow (carry) bit resides at nco_sum_q[NcoWidth], which is not bit 16 when NcoWidth < 16. If downstream baud‑tick logic expects the overflow at a fixed bit position (e.g., nco_sum_q[16]), the tick may be missed or falsely triggered.
uncertain_points.cond: NcoWidth < 16 and overflow is consumed elsewhere.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect baud‑rate generation, leading to UART timing errors or communication failure.
